question: In 2022, the National Green Tribunal advised which of the following Ministries to form a three-member panel to formulate safeguards and guidelines to be followed by the State Environment Impact Assessment Authorities?

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2022, the National Green Tribunal advised the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change** to form a three-member panel.
 
• This panel was tasked with formulating safeguards and guidelines to be followed by the State Environment Impact Assessment Authorities.
 
• The initiative aimed to ensure that environmental assessments and clearances are conducted with greater rigor and transparency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Green Tribunal (NGT)** is a specialized body set up under the National Green Tribunal Act (2010) for expeditious disposal of cases pertaining to environmental issues.
 
• The NGT aims to protect the environment, conserve forests, and other natural resources while ensuring the enforcement of any legal right relating to the environment.
 
• The **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change** is the nodal agency in the administrative structure of the Central Government for planning, promotion, coordination, and overseeing the implementation of India's environmental and forestry policies and programs.
